state.paragraph: On September 21, 2013, the members of the Transaction Committee called the representative of CSC/Pamplona to propose that Mac-Gray was prepared to move forward with CSC/Pamplona on an exclusive basis for two weeks subject to CSC/Pamplona increasing their all-cash purchase price to $21.25 per share. Later that same day, the representative of CSC/Pamplona called the members of the Transaction Committee to confirm that CSC/Pamplona were willing to increase their all-cash purchase price to $21.25 per share as a last and best offer, provided that Mac-Gray agree to a two week period of exclusive negotiations. The representative of CSC/Pamplona also requested that shares of Mac-Gray common stock owned beneficially and of record by Mr. MacDonald and his immediate family be subject to a customary voting agreement, which we refer to as the MacDonald voting agreements.

ledger_rows.Note: Final-round proposal, up from $19.50 (#28); Formal as a response to the final solicitation. Pamplona commits 100% of the capital; only confirmatory diligence followed (Light). Requests 2-week exclusivity.
By phone to BofA: confirms #31 as its best and final offer, answering the final solicitation. The 09/10 bid had no firm financing commitment and none is reported since (Heavy).

Party B values its bid at $21.50: $19.00 cash plus options for 10% of new equity, which it values at $2.50 and which vest on a five-year target. Debt-and-equity financing, no commitment reported (Heavy).
Did not submit or reaffirm its $16.00-$17.00 IOI (#32) and gave no reason. Reported on 09/19; not seen again.
Preferred bidder and price requirement: CSC/Pamplona is best on value, certainty and risk (Party B's options and financing riskier). Exclusivity offered at $21.25; MacDonald supports $21.25.

Raised from $20.75 (#35) the same day the committee asked. Conditioned on 2-week exclusivity; asks for voting agreements from MacDonald. Pamplona funds 100%, no financing contingency; confirmatory diligence only (Light).
Executed, authorized 09/23; exclusive until 5 p.m. 10/12/2013. Ends if CSC/Pamplona adversely changes the $21.25 final proposal. CSC/Pamplona then got full data-room access.
Inferred: displaced when exclusivity with CSC/Pamplona was executed; not reported told. On 09/18 it declined to improve its $18.00-$19.00 range (#36).

Inferred date: displaced by exclusivity with CSC/Pamplona. Reason from the committee on 09/19: Party B's options were contingent and deferred, and its financing riskier, despite the higher face value.

bid.instructions: `paragraph` reports that a bidder submits, revises, confirms or reaffirms a priced proposal, indication of interest or offer for the company. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
